My new regular spot!
Aug 2019
This place has everything you need for a chill, comfortable and classy night. You have the option of outdoor seating, upstairs to look over at the beautiful backlit wall of booze, high chairs under stylish lights, or my favorite spot, right by the bar. The cocktails are one of the best I've had in the city and at such a fair price. It's like having dinner and a show watching the bartenders make drinks. They're skilled in mixing, pouring and lighting a few things on fire too. 

Stop by for happy hour between 5-9PM for 80k cocktails!

Needs more recognition!
Aug 2019 • Friends
Not sure why this place doesn’t have more hype, but I love this place and I’ve been a few times. The bartenders are extremely talented and all their drinks extremely good. Compared to a lot of the places with similar styles, this place is less expensive. They also have happy hour for 80,000 which is a steal. Another kicker, you can hear yourself over the music. Check it out!!! 

P.S also recommend trying the chessboard! And the whiskey sour.

Wow! Spicy off the charts!
Oct 2018 • Friends
Great place that is unassuming from the outside but open up to a lovely, well designed three-story space. Lovely bar, good wine. 

The peach sliders are to die for. The mussels were gorgeous, supple, smooth... until you the sauce bites back with its hotness! Watch out and you may want them to tone it down...

Would I go again? Yes. With a group or a date this would be a fun place!
